int_name: N FRONT ST & E SPENCER AVE

result.summary: The environment features a wide two-lane roadway with faded crosswalk markings and no active traffic control at the pedestrian crossing. While sidewalks are present on both sides, the lack of physical traffic calming and the proximity to a large institutional building suggest a high-exposure environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Traffic Control
hazards.description: There are no stop signs, signals, or pedestrian warning signs at this crossing despite the wide roadway and adjacent institutional land use.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection area in the center of the image

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb on the left side of the image may block the view between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the roadway near the crossing

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility 'ladder' or 'continental' markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Rectangular Rapid Flashing Beacons (RRFB)
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-activated flashing lights to alert drivers to the presence of people crossing.

result.summary: The intersection features a marked zebra crosswalk across a side street but lacks traffic control devices like stop signs or signals for the main thoroughfare. The wide, unmarked roadway and presence of parked vehicles near the crossing create potential visibility and speed-related risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Uncontrolled Crossing
hazards.description: The main roadway lacks stop signs or signals at the intersection with the marked crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection center

hazards.name: Wide Unmarked Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable lane positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

hazards.name: Sight Line Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the side street are positioned close to the crosswalk, potentially obscuring pedestrians from approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the side street

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve the visibility of pedestrians to drivers.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Add clear lane markings and speed humps or a raised crosswalk to manage vehicle speeds.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and signalized pedestrian controls. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks and signals are present, the wide roadway and lack of physical traffic calming measures or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure.

hazards.name: Poor Daylighting
hazards.description: A vehicle is parked very close to the crosswalk on the right side, potentially obstructing the sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image, near the crosswalk entrance

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Exposure
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross two lanes of traffic without a median refuge or curb extensions to shorten the exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground, across the main roadway

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street intersection with a traffic signal but no visible pedestrian signals. Crosswalk markings are present but heavily faded, and parked cars along the curb may obstruct visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Faded crosswalk markings
hazards.description: The painted lines for the crosswalk are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground across the intersection

hazards.name: Visual obstruction from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles near the corner block the sightlines between pedestrians and oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: The signalized intersection lacks dedicated walk/don't-walk indicators for pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side at the traffic light pole

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse markings with high-visibility continental style markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers to provide clear crossing information.
